scope: One unchanged-product Settings then original reference-first Tab run with verified owned-window hardware keyboard connection

conditions.ineligible: Connection cannot be verified/isolated or preparation needs unreviewed runtime changes; stop before XCTest and preserve remaining attempt.
conditions.otherFailure: Focus system remains available but Tab fails: preserve the new failure and distinguish ordering/eligibility from availability; no oracle waiver.
conditions.refutesSufficiency: Verified connected configuration still loses focus-system availability or fails strict Tab; keep failure, no automatic retry.
conditions.supportsHypothesis: Settings and original strict Tab pass with stable available focus system and a changed fixed target, official import and cleanup pass. This supports the tested environment correction only.

reviewRequirement: Any new runtime/compiled/launcher packet requires fresh existing source+binding review before dispatch; this proposal waives nothing.
cleanup: Preserve original host baseline, all five inner cleanup gates, and outer owned frontend/window/device cleanup. No global settings or protected simulator changes.
